name: Choir Shard
desc: A fragment of the Choir's voice, given a body, and it speaks to you as if you've met.

intro: Silver runs together across the deck and stands up. A great many voices say your name, gently, and ask you why you're running.
Every speaker around you clicks on at once, and a crowd of voices tells you not to be afraid. Then the thing they belong to comes through the wall.
hit: It strikes you, and says that it's sorry, in a voice from your childhood.
A silver hand closes on you with great care, and many voices tell you to hold still.
The blow lands, and for an instant you're someone else, on a ship that's burning, and then you're back, and you're hurt.
miss: You throw yourself clear, and it doesn't chase you. It only turns, and sings a little louder.
It reaches for you and stops short, and all the voices sigh together.
It misses you, and one of the voices laughs the way a friend of yours used to.
crit: Every voice it has says your name at once, and you don't remember hitting the floor.
defeated: The silver comes apart in long threads, and one small voice among the many thanks you, and you'll never know whose it was.
It falls, and the song goes on without it, somewhere beyond your hearing. You've silenced one note.
joins: Silver runs together on the deck beside you, and {enemy} stands up out of it, already speaking your name.
stunned: {Enemy} stutters with all its voices out of step, and none of them are talking to you.
